verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and back-office platform covering registered agent, compliance, accounting, tax, mailroom and banking access. Document workflows are a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on e-signature or on sending one document to many recipients at once. The 'apply to more than one service at a time' claim concerns banking-partner applications, not document bulk-send, and does not transfer.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can bulk-send the same document to many recipients at once
